title: Sony says all new PlayStation games from both first- and third-party developers will be sold in digital formats from January 2028, ending physical game discs (Stephen Totilo/Game File)
summary: Stephen Totilo / Game File: Sony says all new PlayStation games from both first- and third-party developers will be sold in digital formats from January 2028, ending physical game discs — The end of an era, a potential fatal blow to video games as physical media, and a hint of what's in store for the PS6?
